entities.name: Krieghelm
entities.description: A fortress carved into a granite mountain in the Tirran Mountains of southwestern Jamuraa on Dominaria.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: Emperor-Tyrant whose keep was Krieghelm during Johan's War.

entities.name: Tirras
entities.description: City in the foothills below Krieghelm.

events.summary: Hazezon Tamar and Adira Strongheart, imprisoned in Krieghelm, escaped through Hazezon's magic and a rescue party led by Jedit Ojanen.
events.quote: they managed to escape through a combination of Hazezon's magic and a rescue party led by Jedit Ojanen

relations.note: Krieghelm was his keep and base of operations.
relations.quote: Krieghelm was the keep of Emperor-Tyrant Johan
a rescue party led by Jedit Ojanen
